## History

Shirley was born in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia), and spent her early childhood as an orphan experiencing hard labor with Mrs. [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) and Mrs. [Hammond](../character/hammond.md) before being placed in an asylum. While being driven down the shore road toward [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), Shirley shared the history of her childhood with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), whose pity was stirred by Shirley's starved life. Later, while attending the Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) commencement with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), and [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), Shirley won the Avery scholarship. During a summer vacation in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) spent feeling lonely over her strained friendship with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), Shirley enjoyed visits with [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), and Miss Lavendar. While walking in the park during a rainstorm, Shirley was rescued by Royal Gardner, who walked her back to Patty's Place and subsequently sent her roses.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER V. ## Quotes

> "Fare thee well, my beloved friend. Henceforth we must be as strangers though living side by side. But my heart will ever be faithful to thee."
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P12](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0012)

> “I’m going back to school,” she announced. “That is all there is left in life for me, now that my friend has been ruthlessly torn from me. In school I can look at her and muse over days departed.”
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017)

> “I think he has only been its nominal head for many years,” said Anne. “He is a very old man; his nephews are really at the head of the institution.”
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P35](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0035)

> “If I had been the boy you sent for,” said Anne wistfully, “I’d be able to help you so much now and spare you in a hundred ways. I could find it in my heart to wish I had been, just for that.”
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P40](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0040)

> "I know by experience that it’s very unpleasant to have one’s name spelled wrong and I suppose it must be even worse to have it pronounced wrong."
>
> — Shirley — [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P16](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0016)

## Relationships

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gilbert-blythe--shirley.md)

[Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) initially built their relationship on an intense academic rivalry during their school years and at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). Over time, their dynamic softened into friendship, marked by brief moments of romantic tension such as when they tidied [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) together after a wedding. After learning that [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is critically ill with typhoid fever, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) suffers through a night of vigil and comes to the sudden realization that she loves him and always has.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P14](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017), +13 more_

- Rival of — academic rivals in school  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036)</sub>

### [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--shirley.md)

[Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) are friendly chums who interact during Anne's frequent visits to Miss Lavendar at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) confides her worries about Miss Lavendar's mood to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), which prompts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to plan extended visits to help out. Together, they assist Miss Lavendar with her dressmaking and wedding preparations, and observe the happy reconciliation between Miss Lavendar and [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md).

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P1](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0001), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P7](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0007), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), +20 more_

- Friend of — chums (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048), [v3 ch.Revelation P0](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0000)</sub>

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/paul-irving--shirley.md)

[Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) acts as Paul's teacher and mentor, quickly establishing a warm connection with him on her first day at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school. [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) becomes her favorite student, bonding with her over flowers and imaginative compositions. Beyond the classroom, the two share a close friendship as they take walks together to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and visit Miss Lavendar.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), +24 more_

- Friend of — student fond of his teacher (since v2)  <sub>[v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021)</sub>

### [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/shirley--stella-maynard.md)

[Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) maintain a close friendship as correspondents who exchange letters and confidences. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) writes to [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) to share amusing anecdotes about her teaching experiences at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school and to highlight compositions written by her students.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Douglas P18](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0018)_
